name: Wada Dream
source: Colours from Sanzo Wada's A Dictionary of Color Combinations (1933-34), combination 176: data by https://github.com/dblodorn/sanzo-wada, screen colours by https://github.com/mattdesl/dictionary-of-colour-combinations (both MIT); the text colour and the panel-edge line are the book's Violet Blue and Carmine, from other combinations; the rest are mixed, with white where lighter
